findings.description: `:109` tests `c.req.proxy` and enters the proxy path without any `..` check; `local()` at `:80` is only reached when the location is not a proxy. Moving the check into the decode (as the other sixteen builds do) closes it.
findings.title: Dispatch order is the root cause: the proxy branch is taken before `local()` can run the guard

limitations: The proxy never executes; all RCE is on the upstream host
Absolute-form findings are negatives and need nothing but a proxied prefix location
